ratings_why.fun: Every gold is a cost and a trigger at once, and hold-or-clear, pay-or-let-Arne-eat-it and pawn-or-sell are real choices each turn.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7: debt is a negative resource that feeds itself, and other people pay it for you (losers, killers, foreign units), which no tribe today does.

verdict_why: The Ledger already ties nearly every card together; what's left are ideas for the two loose cards, not fixes.

points.text: Off-label line the design doesn't list: go short on interest on purpose to grow an IOU to 5, then clear it for a full Grandmother Corbie payout. Worth naming as a build so players find it.
Arne pulls against paying off: borrowed gold from Thought can be fed to Arne instead of the Ledger, while Silas Glint already paid out on the borrow. A lovely three-card knot; keep it.
The Silver-Spoon Magpie never touches the Ledger. Let each stolen keyword pay 1 off your oldest IOU, so it feeds Collect in the fight like the Jackdaw.
Sorrow's fenced copy could be bought on credit (Borrow its price), so the loss-side card also writes slips for the ravens.

With Seven out, holding debt costs nothing, so clearing only happens through Skim and the Enforcer. That's fine as a capstone, but a reason to clear with Seven out (Joy, Corbie) is what keeps the late game a decision.

standouts.why: Pawning is borrow, retrigger and triple bank in one card, and the Bagman's Skim can bring the unit home paid for by the loser.
Turns other tribes' units into payers: debt relief, Collect triggers and Shield for a foreign carry.
Doubles both halves (Collect and clears), so it rewards whichever way you run the Ledger.

weakest.why: A strong counter-pick, but it stands outside the Ledger engine.
Its only tie to the tribe is sitting beside Joy.
A plain body with a debt; fine as an entry card, but no decision once played.

flags.note: Seven plus a full Ledger plus Memory gives 10 free Collects a turn and a max Corbie's Eldest buff, with no cost to holding.
Golden Memory with golden Corbie on 5-gold clears is the runaway high roll the designer named.
A lone pawn IOU plus the Bagman means every win is +3 gold and a free replay.
